title: THE HALL OF MIRRORS // THE CORRIDORS OF QARTH
narrative: Within the decaying, windowless palace of the Warlocks of Qarth, space folded back upon itself in a recursive nightmare. In the Hall of Mirrors, Pyat Pree's purple lips parted in a bitter grimace as he drank shades of the evening. Each mirror showed a different timeline: one where Daenerys burned King's Landing to ash, one where the Others froze the Rhoyne solid, and one where George R.R. Martin sat before a DOS computer in 2026, still typing the word 'capon'. The warlocks fed upon the temporal distortions, whispering curses across the Narrow Sea to snare the dragons.
